# Fate UI v0.8.10-beta8

Fixes the delete confirmation size in compact mode, unblocks the session list after a delete, and keeps the session list identical (same order) whether a folder is focused or not.

## Session list fixes

- **Compact delete confirmation.** The "Delete this session?" confirm now has a compact variant that fits the unified preview row height, instead of oversized text and buttons.
- **Delete no longer locks the list.** Deleting a saved session no longer disables every other session until the disk refresh finishes. The delete runs in the background and updates the list when it lands; you can click another session immediately.
- **1:1 session order across focus changes.** Background/preview folders now use the same sort (recent / oldest / alphabetical / manual) as the active folder, and the focus-carry cache stores the already-sorted list. Switching between `piagent-fategui` and `ethereal_porezna` no longer reorders the session list.

## Compatibility and installers

No migration is needed. Existing projects, Pi sessions, settings, themes, and folder history are unchanged.

GitHub Actions builds and tests this release on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64. The prerelease contains installers plus `SHA256SUMS`:

- Windows x64: NSIS `.exe`
- macOS arm64 and x64: `.dmg` and `.pkg`
- Linux x64: `.AppImage` and `.deb`

Public beta installers remain unsigned. Windows SmartScreen or macOS Gatekeeper may show an unknown-publisher warning. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.
